page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with the deployment.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention, positioning this instance class for workloads requiring stable compute density. Given the balanced memory-to-core ratio and lack of local storage, it is designed for enterprise applications, web serving clusters, middle-tier application servers, and general-purpose business-critical workloads that rely on network-attached storage.
